name: mimuz-link
description: MIDI over ESP-NOW link layer for mi:muz devices: library, examples, web console and firmware uploader

scripts.server: cd ./web && npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && (npx --yes pm2 delete mimuz-link-console || true) && npx --yes pm2 start ./app.mjs --name mimuz-link-console
scripts.version: node ./web/firmware/sync-version.mjs && git add libs/mimuz-link/library.properties libs/mimuz-link/src/mimuz_link_proto.h web/package.json web/package-lock.json

author: D.F.Mac. @TripArts Music
